You're right, and I'm sorry. Your order Shop···· was for the Hammer Miner Thor P2 (10TH/s), and the photo you sent is clearly a Hammer DC08, which is a Scrypt miner, so it will never mine BTC or BCH. That's a picking mistake at our Chattanooga warehouse, not anything you did.

Please leave the DC08 boxed as it is and don't set it up. We'll be sending you a prepaid return label so it costs you nothing to send back, and your Thor P2 goes out to you from the same warehouse once the mix-up is squared away. I don't want to promise you a label that hasn't been printed yet, so here's where it stands: a colleague picks this up Monday at 10am Eastern and the label plus the details come straight to this email address, so you don't need to do anything in the meantime.

Thanks for the clear photo, it made this easy to confirm, and sorry again for the trouble.
